channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: Texas primary results 2026
item.description: Texas voters are deciding two hotly contested Senate primaries, with Congresswoman Jasmine Crockett facing state Rep. James Talarico in the Democratic race and Republican incumbent John Cornyn facing challenges from Ken Paxton and Wesley Hunt. In redrawn congressional districts in the Houston area, Al Green and Christian Menefee are among the Democratic candidates in TX-18, while Briscoe Cain and Alex Mealer are vying for the GOP nomination in TX-9.

item.title: Orlando Sanchez and Marty Lancton lead as GOP runoff appears likely in Harris County judge race
item.description: Republicans are seeking to win back the Harris County judge seat, which has been held by a Democrat since the 2018 election.

item.title: Christian Menefee leads Al Green for Democratic nomination in newly redrawn TX-18
item.description: Menefee was sworn in as the 18th Congressional District representative last month after winning a special election. Green has represented the 9th Congressional District since 2005.

item.title: John Cornyn leads Ken Paxton as GOP Senate primary heads to runoff
item.description: The incumbent Cornyn, seeking a fifth term in Washington, drew primary challenges from the Texas AG Paxton and Houston Congressman Wesley Hunt.

item.title: Winners, losers and runoffs: How Texans’ November ballot is shaping up after the primaries
item.description: From the governorship to the U.S. Senate race to attorney general, here's who we know will face off for statewide offices in November — and who's heading to a runoff in May.

item.title: Alex Mealer, Briscoe Cain poised for runoff in Republican primary for new TX-9
item.description: The Houston-area district was redrawn to favor Republicans but could still be in play for Democrats in November, according to a local political expert.

item.title: Annise Parker leads Letitia Plummer in bid for Democratic nomination in Harris County Judge race
item.description: Matt Salazar also campaigned for county judge as incumbent Lina Hidalgo, a fellow Democrat, did not seek reelection.

item.title: Texas Rep. Gina Hinojosa wins Democratic nomination, will face Gov. Greg Abbott in November
item.description: A win for Abbott in November would put the Republican on track to becoming the longest serving governor of Texas. For Hinojosa, an Austin-area Texas House member, a win would break a 30-plus year Republican streak in the office.

item.title: James Talarico holds slim lead against Jasmine Crockett in Democratic primary for U.S. Senate
item.description: Talarico and Crockett, competing for a place on November ballots in Texas, are seeking to give Democrats their first win in a statewide election in more than 30 years.

item.title: Galveston County Judge Mark Henry leads in primary in bid for fifth term
item.description: Henry drew a challenge in the Republican primary from Chris Kinard, the wife of longtime Galveston County District Clerk John Kinard.
